selected_evidence.requirement: Keep installed curl at its current version during system updates
selected_evidence.summary: curl was 7.76.1-31.el9; the native versionlock plugin was installed and pinned that release. Although 7.76.1-40.el9_8.7 was available, the held curl update reported nothing to do, and a full 211-package upgrade preview contained zero exact curl rows.

Baseline boot ID and healthy package state were captured; the reboot was acknowledged; boot ID changed from a0d04bc6-5f90-4c7b-8283-51dd6932056f to 445d29e8-1a3c-4a18-80e7-6ebbe8623922; afterward the system was running, curl remained functional at 7.76.1-31.el9, and the version lock still prevented its update.
